detailed_description: Image to WebP converts JPEG, PNG, or GIF files into static WebP images in the browser. Pick one or more images, drag the quality slider between 10 and 100, then click Convert to draw each image to a canvas and call canvas.toDataURL('image/webp', quality). The list shows each image with its original size and, after conversion, the converted size and savings percentage; a total savings percentage is shown above the list. Per-file Download saves a single .webp, and Download All saves multiple converted files together as a ZIP via JSZip. Animated GIFs are flattened to a single WebP frame; the tool does not preserve GIF animation, does not offer a lossless toggle, and does not accept other formats like BMP, TIFF, or SVG.
usage_steps: Drag the quality slider between 10 and 100
Click the upload area and select one or more JPEG, PNG, or GIF files
Review the list of images with their original sizes
Click Convert to encode each file as WebP via canvas.toDataURL
Read per-file converted size and savings, plus the total savings above the list
Click Download on a row for a single .webp, or Download All to save multiple files as a ZIP
usage_examples: Re-encode a folder of JPEG photos as WebP to cut the size before uploading to a blog
Convert a single PNG screenshot to WebP at quality 80 for use in a documentation page
Try a few quality settings on the same image and compare the savings percentages
Pack a small batch of converted WebP files into a single ZIP for sharing
